rule: Position i uses an unknown independently random GP29 permutation indexed by key class k_i. The test uses marginal rune frequencies, so it does not require guessing the permutations or key phase.
corpus: Canonical LP2-00–55 runes. Pooled statistic uses 12,956 runes; sectioned statistic uses source segments 7–9 and 11–15 (12,947 runes), omitting nine-rune segment 10 by the source's declared rule.
control_gate: Before LP2: 200 synthetic ciphers each at V=29,256,1024; mean chi-square within 15% of the model prediction. At true V=1024, zero of 200 hard false exclusions at P<=0.0001 and <=10% at P<=0.05. A uniform-additive-key structural control is reported separately.
decision: For effective key classes V, exclude that specified independent-random-permutation model when the lower-tail P of the observed chi-square is <=0.0001. Pooled model uses one random tabula; sectioned model draws a fresh tabula for each of eight selected sections, evaluated against 2,000,000 seeded chi-square draws.
post_run_diagnostic: The source additionally scales observed statistics by the additive-control mean/28=0.939 after seeing the source results. This is a sensitivity calculation, not the declared gate or preregistered exclusion rule.
limitations: The bound is conditional on independent random substitution alphabets drawn by key class and the solved LP1 plaintext coincidence used for calibration. It does not test Vigenere/Latin-square tabulae, arbitrary correlated alphabets, transposition, or cipher layers.
